title: console.table beats console.log for lists
why_it_matters: Small debugging habits save a lot of squinting.
explanation: console.table prints an array of objects as a neat table. Wrapping a variable in braces, console.log({ users }), also prints its name as a label, so you always know which value is which. Small habits that make debugging faster.
try_it: Use console.table on an array from your own project.
